question: What is the monthly revenue trend for 2020?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.year, c.month, SUM(gl.amount) as monthly_revenue FROM general_ledger gl JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON gl.organization_id = coa.organization_id AND gl.account_key = coa.account_key JOIN calendar c ON gl.date = c.date WHERE coa.class = 'Trading account' AND c.year = 2020 AND gl.organization_id = 1 GROUP BY c.year, c.month ORDER BY c.year, CASE c.month WHEN 'Jan' THEN 1 WHEN 'Feb' THEN 2 WHEN 'Mar' THEN 3 WHEN 'Apr' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'Jun' THEN 6 WHEN 'Jul' THEN 7 WHEN 'Aug' THEN 8 WHEN 'Sep' THEN 9 WHEN 'Oct' THEN 10 WHEN 'Nov' THEN 11 WHEN 'Dec' THEN 12 END
notes: Returns 12 rows

question: What is the quarterly revenue trend for 2020?

notes: Returns 4 rows (Qtr 1 to Qtr 4)

question: How did revenue change from 2019 to 2020?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2020 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END) as revenue_2020, SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2019 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END) as revenue_2019, SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2020 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2019 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END) as absolute_change, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2020 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2019 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2019 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) as percent_change FROM general_ledger gl JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON gl.organization_id = coa.organization_id AND gl.account_key = coa.account_key JOIN calendar c ON gl.date = c.date WHERE coa.class = 'Trading account' AND c.year IN (2019, 2020) AND gl.organization_id = 1
notes: Single row comparing total revenue between 2019 and 2020 for Kuvalis

question: How did total revenue in 2020 compare to 2019 for Vandervort by country?

question: How did total expenses in 2021 compare to 2020 for Vandervort?
